subject: Sungrove: post-upgrade latency/error spike after modelpack v4.2 (quant Q8)
messages:
From: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@sungrove.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Park <jason.park@sungrove.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: sudden p95/p99 and 500s after modelpack v4.2 (Q8)

Connor —

We're seeing a sharp regression in Sungrove's production traffic starting ~08:50 PT after the modelpack v4.2 rollout (quant profile QINT8). Symptoms: p95 up ~430ms -> ~1.2s, p99 up to 2.9s, and a spike in 5xxs (mainly 502 gateway and some 504). Throughput also dropped briefly as retry logic kicked in. This is affecting our checkout path (critical).

Attached are a sampling of traces, our SLO dashboard screenshot, and an aggregated error log from 08:45-09:10. We reverted the client-side retries but cannot change the server modelpack. We rolled forward with no other config changes. Can you confirm if Redwood pushed anything to Sungrove's dedicated pool?

This is high severity for us — our ops and on-call are actively paged. Please escalate immediately.

Thanks,
Ellie Turner
Head of Platform — Sungrove
[Attachment: p99-trace.svg (image/svg+xml)]
[Attachment: sungrove_error_logs.zip (zip)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@sungrove.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:28:15 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden p95/p99 and 500s after modelpack v4.2 (Q8)

Ellie —

Thanks for the quick heads-up and the artifacts. I'm sorry you're seeing this. We rolled the v4.2 modelpack with the new QINT8 quant profile to your pool as scheduled at 08:40 PT; no other infra changes were made.

Immediate actions from our side:
- I've looped in Irene (runtime) and Marissa (CS lead) — we'll validate telemetry and roll a controlled canary rollback if necessary.
- Irene: can you pull per-shard p95/p99 traces and CPU/GPU utilization for the 08:30-09:30 window and confirm KV cache hit rates?
- Marissa/Rishi: pls prepare an exec summary and proposed customer credit/comp plan in case we need to escalate.

Ellie — we'll aim to provide an update within 30 minutes and the rollback ETA if we confirm the modelpack is the root cause. Apologies again; I know this is impacting checkout.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal: incident-ack.txt (note)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: sudden p95/p99 and 500s after modelpack v4.2 (Q8)

Quick ops snapshot:
- Confirmed: the v4.2 QINT8 variant was rolled to Sungrove's dedicated GPU pool at 08:40:12 PT via the rollout policy 'scheduled-pool-roll'.
- Observed: immediate increase in per-request decode time avg +2.6x on GPU 3/4; CPU-side queueing increased due to longer kernel runtimes; KV cache hit rate unchanged.
- Error pattern: 502s concentrated on nodes with higher seq_len requests; trace shows timeouts at the serving runtime's policy-level fallback after queued kernel wait (~1.5s).
- Mitigation candidate: immediate canary rollback to prior modelpack v4.1 (no-quant or QINT16) for 25% of traffic for 15m to measure impact. Full rollback is available but will take ~18 minutes to drain and replace.

I'll start a 25% canary rollback now if we have signoff. Also instrumenting an emergency (short) lowering of max_batch_size for the model to reduce kernel contention as a temporary mitigation, but that will increase cost.

Irene
Irene Choi
Infra / Runtime Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pprof-samples-08-50-09-10.txt (text)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:40:22 -07:00
Subject: RE: sudden p95/p99 and 500s after modelpack v4.2 (Q8)

Do the 25% canary now. Irene, start with canary rollback to v4.1 QINT16 and reduce max_batch_size to 8 for the canary nodes. Track p95, p99, 5xx, and throughput minute-by-minute and post the first 10m summary to the incident doc (link below).

Marissa/Rishi — prep a short customer note: A) we detected an impact traced to the v4.2 QINT8 rollout; B) we are initiating a canary rollback and temporary batch-size mitigation; C) outline next steps (full rollback if canary fails, customer credits, follow-up RCA). Keep tone apologetic and clear.

Connor

[Attachment: Incident Doc: https://drive.redwood/sungrove/incident-20270503]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir_patel@redwood.com>, CEO <ceo@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sungrove impact — requesting CX/credits + exec awareness

Looping execs and finance: Sungrove (large checkout volume customer, ARR $4.2M) is impacted by a performance regression after our v4.2 modelpack rollout. Irene's canary rollback is in progress (25% now); early telemetry (first 8m) shows p95 falling back ~40% on canary nodes and 5xxs declining but not yet to baseline.

Asks:
- Finance: please provision a preliminary goodwill credit (estimate 10-15% monthly) while we complete RCA; we'll finalize after RCA.
- CEO/ops: we may need approval for a full immediate rollback if the canary does not normalize within 30m. Full rollback impact on capacity is non-trivial; ops will need a quick green light.
- Legal/Contracts: hold on finalizing credit language until we confirm SLA breach windows.

I'll draft a brief customer-facing update to send at 13:15 PT with current mitigation steps. Connor, please coordinate.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sla-window-snapshot.txt (text)]

From: Ellie Turner <ellie.turner@sungrove.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Park <jason.park@sungrove.com>, Sungrove Support <support@sungrove.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden p95/p99 and 500s after modelpack v4.2 (Q8) — update and logs attached

Connor / Team —

Thanks for the updates and for starting the canary rollback. Our ops reports that checkout error rate improved significantly on canary traffic and overall p95 is trending down. We're attaching a full SLO window and a few sample failing requests that still show server-side 502s.

We appreciate the quick response. We expect a formal RCA and a proposal for compensation/credit. Also request the timeline for a full rollback if the canary stabilizes but issues persist on non-canary nodes.

Ellie Turner
Head of Platform — Sungrove
